title: ALLSTATE CORP 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Allstate Corporation filed an 8-K current report on April 16, 2026, registering securities including common stock, subordinated debentures, and preferred stock on the NYSE. The filing references a March 2026 monthly release announcing estimated catastrophe losses and policies in force as Exhibit 99 under Regulation FD.
key_points: Allstate registered common stock (ALL), 5.100% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Debentures due 2053 (ALL.PR.B), and three series of preferred stock (Series H, I, J) on the NYSE.
The filing is made pursuant to Regulation FD, referencing a March 2026 catastrophe loss and policies in force report posted on allstateinvestors.com (Exhibit 99).
Exhibit 99 is furnished but not filed, pursuant to Instruction B.2 of Form 8-K.
The filing was signed by Eric K. Ferren, Senior Vice President, Controller and Chief Accounting Officer, dated April 16, 2026.
why_it_matters: This is a routine SEC disclosure filing from an insurance company. It does not contain information relevant to market structure or macro catalysts. The catastrophe loss reference is an internal operational metric for Allstate, not a market-moving announcement.
